value.answer: Good that you're reaching out. If you're in crisis right now, don't wait on a referral: go to the nearest emergency room. The free option in Toronto is the Ontario Structured Psychotherapy Program, which gives adults free, publicly funded CBT for depression and anxiety. No health card needed, and you can refer yourself at ontariohealth.ca/osp. It isn't for everyone and it isn't crisis support. It doesn't cover unstructured talk therapy, so if that's what you want, low-cost clinics are another route. The Centre for Training in Psychotherapy listed $45 a session with a supervised student, and Fika offers online therapy at $65 a session with a free 15-minute consult. Those prices are from older listings and may have changed, and I can't confirm any of these clinics is taking new clients right now.
